SciPath - Your Path To Learning STEM, Biology, and Chemistry


SciPath is the best learning platform for STEM, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and much more. We provide video lessons, educational quizzes, fun educational interactables, study flashcards, and 1 on 1 tutoring with experts in science.

Our Team

Lily - Biology Teacher with 12 years of experience in biochemistry, biology, and has a bachelor of science at USYD.

Thomas - With over 7 years in STEM, Thomas has worked with students across the globe online and in-person. Thomas is a great choice if you need help.
